title: PHS 398 Career Development Award Supplemental Form
description: Research strategy, supporting documents and citizenship for a PHS 398 career development application.
notes: No answers are pre- or post-populated. The upload service assigns file IDs.

The empty form requires Research Strategy and a Yes or No citizenship answer. Candidate Information and Specific Aims are described as required in help, but the DAT marks both optional, the PDF has no required markers for them and the XSD allows omission. Follow the applicable opportunity instructions.
Answering No requires a non-U.S. citizenship status. The permanent-residency checkbox is optional and applies only to applicants with a temporary U.S. visa.
The XML omits a previous citizenship follow-up when the applicant changes to an answer for which it no longer applies.

The Introduction is required and enabled for Resubmission or Revision. The Progress Report Publication List is enabled for Renewal or Resubmission and required for Renewal. The DAT clears these attachments when their application type does not apply. Vertebrate Animals is required when the other form says animals are used.
The DAT allows one Appendix group with up to 10 PDFs. The XSD allows up to 100 PDFs in that group.

DAT 0-1 burden statement: Public reporting burden for this collection of information is estimated to average 10 hours per response, including the time for reviewing instructions, searching existing data sources, gathering and maintaining the data needed, and completing and reviewing the collection of information. An agency may not conduct or sponsor, and a person is not required to respond to, a collection of information unless it displays a currently valid OMB control number. Send comments regarding this burden estimate or any other aspect of this collection of information, including suggestions for reducing this burden, to: NIH, Project Clearance Branch, 6705 Rockledge Drive, MSC 7974, Bethesda, MD 20892-7974, ATTN: PRA (0925-0001). Do not return the completed form to this address.
risks: Introduction, Progress Report Publication List and Vertebrate Animals depend on other form answers. The definition shows instructions for these fields. Runtime enforcement requires those answers.
The XSD allows the whole attachment wrapper to be absent. The applicant form requires Research Strategy, as marked in the DAT and PDF.
Actual PDF content, file ownership and page limits require the application upload service and opportunity instructions.
